description: Evaluation cases for the Supply Response deterministic services. All data is fictional (RL- prefix).

cases.name: Confirmed supplier recovery date
cases.input: Delayed purchase order carries a revised_date inside the horizon.
cases.expected: The revised date is used as the receipt date and the quantity counts as a confirmed receipt.

cases.name: Unconfirmed recovery date
cases.input: Delayed purchase order RL-PO-000101 with revised_date = null.
cases.expected: No receipt is created and the unconfirmed date is reported as an open question.

cases.name: Partial shipment
cases.input: Supplier Alpha offers 3,000 units on 2025-09-06 by air freight.
cases.expected: RL-SCN-002 is executable, costs 28,000.00 and protects 273,000.00 of revenue.

cases.name: Conflicting email and ERP dates
cases.input: Email states no recovery date; ERP carries revised_date 2025-09-20.
cases.expected: The ERP commitment is used and the conflict is surfaced, never silently resolved.

cases.name: Alternate supplier approved
cases.input: Supplier Alpha qualification RL-QUALITY-002 for MAT-10247.
cases.expected: The policy check returns executable = true with no blocking constraint.

cases.name: Alternate supplier not approved
cases.input: Supplier Beta qualification RL-QUALITY-001 for MAT-10247.
cases.expected: RL-SCN-005 is not executable, is ranked last, and is retained as a conditional option.

cases.name: Inventory available at another plant
cases.input: 9,000 usable units transferred from RL-PLANT-02 on 2025-09-03.
cases.expected: No stockout, no affected production orders, zero revenue at risk.

cases.name: No feasible mitigation
cases.input: Accept the delay with no expedite, transfer, or resequencing.
cases.expected: Revenue protected is 0.00 and the full baseline exposure is retained.

cases.name: Premium freight above approval threshold
cases.input: Premium freight of 28,000.00 against a 25,000.00 threshold.
cases.expected: requires_approval = true and finance_approver is added to the approver roles.

cases.name: Missing or stale collaboration evidence
cases.input: A supplier with no quality qualification record for the part.
cases.expected: The scenario is blocked with code QUALITY_NO_RECORD rather than assumed approved.
